name: @aparte/svelte
description: Svelte wrapper for aparté — an ergonomic <AparteChat> component plus stores over the framework-agnostic web components. Works on Svelte 4 and 5.
//packaging: svelte-package copies the .svelte components and compiles the .ts to .js; tsc emits index.d.ts.
Both are needed: a Svelte library must ship its components (the `svelte` condition) AND a real
JS entry (a bundler that does not add that condition still resolves `default`).
KNOWN GAP, pre-existing and not introduced here: no per-component `.svelte.d.ts` is emitted, so a
consumer's svelte-check does not see AparteChat's props (it does not analyse .svelte inside
node_modules). svelte-package's own type emission produces nothing under pnpm's isolation and fails
silently, even with -t and an explicit --tsconfig. Fixing it needs svelte2tsx resolvable from
@sveltejs/package itself. Until then the props are documented, not compiler-enforced, for consumers.

scripts.build: svelte-package -i src/lib -o dist && tsc -b --emitDeclarationOnly --force && node scripts/strip-dist-tests.mjs
